PFIbox promoter-activity screen

Source: vignettes/pfibox-promoter-activity-screen.Rmd
pfibox-promoter-activity-screen.Rmd

This article documents the DStressR reanalysis of the high-density PFIbox promoter-reporter screen of French, Coutts, and Brown (2018), Cell Systems, doi:10.1016/j.cels.2018.07.004. The deposited data contain colony-level time-course measurements for an E. coli promoter-GFP library under antibiotic treatments. The manuscript analysis reconstructs unscaled promoter activity from the deposited biomass-normalized fluorescence, integrates each colony trajectory, and applies DStressR effect estimation and inference.

Data provenance

The source is Mendeley Data version 1, DOI 10.17632/fmv6vv4bsf.1, under CC BY 4.0. The full object is approximately 1.31 GB. Download and checksum instructions are in the data-folder README. The public processing-code repository is:

https://github.com/sfrench007/pfibox

The local workflow expects the deposited multi-treatment gfpData.Rdata object under:

data-raw/french_pfibox/source/gfpData.Rdata

The French et al. time-course cluster assignment table can be placed in the same source folder when reproducing the cluster-mapping figure. Large source files and derived tables are intentionally not committed. The provenance note is kept in:

data-raw/french_pfibox/README.md

Response construction

The deposited constit.normalized matrices contain biomass-normalized fluorescence q(t). The deposited promoter.activity matrices have already been min-max-scaled per colony. We recover unscaled activity by differencing q(t), retaining difference indices 20–216, and applying quadratic LOESS with span 0.5 on the retained 197-sample grid. Scaling these reconstructed curves recovers the deposited activity to floating-point precision in the audit. The DStressR input is the signed trapezoidal integral of the unscaled activity:

y_i = integral from t_start to T of reconstructed_PA_i(t) dt

The manuscript uses the complete retained grid: 100 minutes through 18 hours under the five-minute acquisition convention. No additional two-hour cutoff is applied. The integration endpoint remains configurable. The DStressR model uses treatment-level perturbations, where each antibiotic-dose combination is a separate perturbation. Repeated colony positions are included as reporter-wise adjustment terms when supported by the filtered data.

Reproduce the analysis

First audit the downloaded source object:

Rscript analysis/french_pfibox/audit_pfibox_data.R

Then run the promoter-activity subset analysis. The values below reproduce the large subset used for the manuscript figure.

PFIBOX_REPORTER_LIMIT=2000 \
PFIBOX_PERTURBATION_LIMIT=100 \
PFIBOX_RESPONSE_SUMMARY=unscaled_integral \
PFIBOX_TIME_WINDOW=all_available \
PFIBOX_PERTURBATION_TARGET=treatment \
PFIBOX_DESIGN=replicate \
PFIBOX_MODEL_PATH=scalable \
Rscript analysis/french_pfibox/run_promoter_activity_analysis.R

This writes the supplied response table, fitted DStressR pair results, and diagnostic summaries under:

analysis/outputs/french_pfibox/temporal_unscaled_integral_analysis/

Prepare ordinary tests and the 10-positive plus 10-negative illustrative selection, then compute the clustering with the settings below:

Rscript analysis/french_pfibox/prepare_integrated_activity_supplement.R
PFIBOX_TIMECOURSE_SELECTION=directional_volcano \
Rscript analysis/french_pfibox/plot_integrated_activity_timecourses.R

export PFIBOX_ANALYSIS_DIR=analysis/outputs/french_pfibox/temporal_unscaled_integral_analysis
export PFIBOX_RUN_TAG=reporters2000_perturbations100_Tall_available_treatment_replicate_scalable_temporal_unscaled_integral
export PFIBOX_CLUSTER_TOP_REPORTERS=2000
export PFIBOX_CLUSTER_LINKAGE=complete
export PFIBOX_CLUSTER_DISTANCE=correlation
export PFIBOX_CLUSTER_OUTPUT_SUFFIX=total_effect_correlation_complete
export PFIBOX_ADJUSTMENT_SCOPE=global
Rscript analysis/french_pfibox/compute_paper_diagnostics.R
Rscript analysis/french_pfibox/map_french_timecourse_clusters_to_destress.R
Rscript analysis/french_pfibox/build_selected_activity_figure.R --target=total

The moderation diagnostic in the supplement compares the same fitted model under moderated and ordinary standard errors:

Rscript analysis/french_pfibox/plot_pfibox_moderation_diagnostic.R --target=total

DStressR model call

The derived tables under data-raw/french_pfibox/derived/ provide observation metadata and long-format scalar responses without loading the large source. Their README records units, transformations, attribution and checksums. They are excluded from the CRAN package build. After joining by observation ID:

design <- read.delim("data-raw/french_pfibox/derived/experimental_design.tsv.gz")
scalar <- read.delim("data-raw/french_pfibox/derived/scalar_responses.tsv.gz")
input <- merge(design, scalar, by = "observation_id", sort = FALSE)

assay <- prepare_assay(
  input,
  reporter = "Promoter",
  perturbation = "Perturbation",
  control = "Control",
  response = "value",
  replicate = "repeat_position"
)

fit <- fit_destress(
  assay,
  technical = "repeat_position",
  testing = "moderated_t",
  adjustment = "global",
  interaction = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

tab <- results(fit, verbose = TRUE)
hits <- call_hits(
  tab,
  fdr = 0.05,
  effect = "total_effect",
  padj = "total_padj_global"
)

The fitted object stores the reporter-wise total-effect fits. The results() step extracts total effects, reporter-relative effects, moderated statistics, and adjusted p-values.

Both BH families are available in the results; the manuscript uses the global family across all 59,301 tests, yielding 5,101 calls at 0.05. It contains 273,792 finite colony responses from 1,797 reporters and 33 treatment levels. The thirteen untreated source arrays are pooled as references, with each source colony-condition represented once.

Figure 6 uses correlation distance and complete linkage for the 1,796 nonconstant reporter profiles. Four manually chosen examples from the saved 20-pair display selection are marked consistently in the heatmap, shown in the 2-by-2 trajectory panel, and labelled in the volcano. They are ompC / Ampicillin-18, msrB / Sulfamethoxazole-18, recN / Ciprofloxacin-18 and rmf / NalidixicAcid-18. These illustrative choices do not change the hypothesis tests.
